Thanks for the warm welcome, I've done that.

[quote=irocco;58790207]Islamic state eh?[/quote]
Yes. Who're you?

[quote=pantagruel;58792496]Yes. Who're you?[/quote]
The Sealiphate of Irocco, a state in search of diplomacy with countries that have their faith as one of the three Abrahamic religions.

[quote=irocco;58792597]The Sealiphate of Irocco, a state in search of diplomacy with countries that have their faith as one of the three Abrahamic religions.[/quote]

Wonderful, shall we roleplay it or do you simply wish to discuss it OOC?

[quote=irocco;58792700]Wonderful, shall we roleplay it or do you simply wish to discuss it OOC?[/quote]
Your choice.

[quote=pantagruel;58792707]Your choice.[/quote]
Then we shall RP it, I wish to expand upon the Sealiphs character so I request you come to Imdekka.

[quote=irocco;58792738]Then we shall RP it, I wish to expand upon the Sealiphs character so I request you come to Imdekka.[/quote]
[i]As the skies cleared, the Pantagrueli Air-Force 1 arrived at its destination of Imdekka, Irocco. In the  plane sat Minister of Defense Hyong-yong chol who was sent to Irocco in a diplomatic mission to establish Pantagruel's first international relations with another country and open the hermit kingdom to the outside world. When the plane finally reached landing distance the pilot would lob an encrypted message to the Iroccoan tower. "[b]This is Air-Force 1, requesting landing.[/b]" He said, his voice stern and defined. [/i]

[quote=pantagruel;58792891][i]As the skies cleared, the Pantagrueli Air-Force 1 arrived at its destination of Imdekka, Irocco. In the  plane sat Minister of Defense Hyong-yong chol who was sent to Irocco in a diplomatic mission to establish Pantagruel's first international relations with another country and open the hermit kingdom to the outside world. When the plane finally reached landing distance the pilot would lob an encrypted message to the Iroccoan tower. "[b]This is Air-Force 1, requesting landing.[/b]" He said, his voice stern and defined. [/i][/quote]
[i]The message would rapidly be unencrypted and replied to swiftly, "Permission granted" Tower control replied with a voice hoarse from many days of work, barking orders at planes, he continued "Pull into runway 27, it's reserved for Diplomatic missions. There will be a car and a driver waiting for you there." just off to the side of the tarmac a sleek black car with a driver dressed in a fine suit awaited it's occupants.[/i]
